title: An agent simulator, from day one

options.label: Yes, in step 1
options.act: `switchboard review simulate` + an in-page dev panel; event scripts as fixtures; used by e2e and films
options.then: Add `switchboard review simulate` and an in-page simulator, used by the tests and the films.

why: Flex builds live arrival against a scripted agent: Next event, Play the rest, Reset, and #demo to play by itself. The same for Review: a switchboard review simulate <script> that plays recorded events (a card arrives, a phase moves, the agent gets blocked) into a project.
It's what we design against, what demo films are filmed with, and what the tests use to check notifications, badges and the menu bar without a real agent.
